lines.text: Zero.

lines.speaker: Dwight
lines.text: Damn It!

lines.speaker: Darryl
lines.text: I'm gonna tell Jim to go  himself.

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: Do you think Andy would ever jump off an exploding building tied to a hose for me?

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Yeah. Definitely.  Hey, what's--Oh, no, come here.  Hey, hey. Come on, huh?

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: I'm still Andy's girlfriend.

lines.speaker: Pete
lines.text: Oh, yeah, of course. I know.

lines.speaker: Erin
lines.text: But you can leave your arm.

lines.speaker: Pam
lines.text: Dwight, want me to get you some eggnog?

lines.speaker: Dwight
lines.text: No, thanks. I'll just have another dumatril. Jim taught me this really cool way to take it. You crush it into a powder, and you snort it up your butt.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Yep, I did say that.

lines.speaker: Pam
lines.text: Jim!

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: What's going on? Where's the belsnickel?

lines.speaker: Pam
lines.text: Oh--Oh my god!

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: What are you doing? Last time I saw you, you were whipping me out of the building.

lines.speaker: Dwight
lines.text: Shh. Let's not speak of that. The Pig Rib! We could totally break the pig rib! I'm gonna dig it out of the trash!

lines.speaker: Pam
lines.text: What happened? Did you miss your bus?

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: No. I just missed my wife.

lines.speaker: Dwight
lines.text: I found it!

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: And I found out that there's a bus at 5:00 a.m.

lines.speaker: Dwight
lines.text: Oh!  Damn It! Jim got the bigger half.

lines.speaker: Darryl
lines.text: Back for more, huh?

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Ooh, nog it. Let me get some nog.  Thanks, Phyllis. Where's Andy?

lines.speaker: Darryl
lines.text: You!

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Oh, hey, man.  Oh, you know what? Before I forget again, I talked to the guys about hiring you. They're gonna bring you in for an interview.

lines.speaker: Darryl
lines.text: That's great.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Right?

lines.speaker: Darryl
lines.text: Thanks, man.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Hey, of course.

lines.speaker: Darryl
lines.text: I shall come by at your convenience.

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Thank you, sir.

lines.speaker: Darryl
lines.text: Whoo!

lines.speaker: Jim
lines.text: Go get 'em.

lines.speaker: Darryl
lines.text: Oh! Whoa!

lines.speaker: Dwight
lines.text: Very impish.

lines.speaker: Toby
lines.text: Two dimes, seven nickels--Well, okay, no, that doesn't add up. It was one quarter and--

lines.speaker: Nellie
lines.text: Shh.

lines.speaker: Toby
lines.text: What? I was just explaining--

lines.speaker: Nellie
lines.text: Shh.

lines.speaker: Toby
lines.text: Why wouldn't it--

lines.speaker: Nellie
lines.text: Shh.

lines.speaker: Toby
lines.text: But why?

lines.speaker: Nellie
lines.text: No...more...talking.

lines.speaker: Toby
lines.text: Are you gonna kiss me?

lines.speaker: Nellie
lines.text: Yes.
